meta.name: prioritize-assumptions
meta.description: Prioritize assumptions using an Impact × Risk matrix and suggest experiments for each. Use when triaging a list of assumptions, deciding what to test first, or applying the assumption prioritization canvas.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用影响×风险矩阵排序假设并设计实验
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需从一堆假设中找出最值得验证的那一个
copy.tagline_en: Prioritize assumptions with an Impact × Risk matrix and design experiments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to decide which assumption to test first

howto.what: 当你提供一组假设时，它会用影响×风险矩阵对每个假设打分，并建议如何测试高影响高风险的假设。
howto.when: 当你列出多个假设，需要决定先测试哪个，或者想用假设优先级画布时触发。

say.text: 帮我优先排序这些产品假设。
say.note: 它会分析每个假设的影响和风险。

say.text: 对高影响高风险的假设设计一个实验。
say.note: 它会给出最小化努力、最大化学习的测试方案。

howto.what_en: When you provide a list of assumptions, it scores each using an Impact × Risk matrix and suggests experiments for high-impact, high-risk ones.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you list multiple assumptions and need to decide which to test first, or when applying the assumption prioritization canvas.

say_en.text: Prioritize these product assumptions for me.
say_en.note: It will analyze impact and risk for each.

say_en.text: Design an experiment for high-impact, high-risk assumptions.
say_en.note: It will propose a minimal-effort, maximal-learning test.
